lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Port Murmur. Gulls, foghorns, and one shy trumpet on the corner of Main Street.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Play the sad one again, Pip. My haddock love the sad one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A white van parks on the pavement. The Quiet Squad climbs out, decibel meters raised.

lines.speaker: hush
lines.text: By order of Mayor Quill and the Silence Act, your trumpet reads eighty-two decibels.

lines.speaker: hush
lines.text: Velvet Heights has filed a complaint. Lower the instrument. Slowly. Silently.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Psst. A march is heading north. Stay in the crowd, out of their sight lines, and grab your tips on the way.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Sorry, Sergeant. The song isn't finished.
